write_up: Your resume points to family services casework, from intake at Lakeview Community Center to child welfare work at Cuyahoga Family Partners. This is a common way to describe casework: the duties are clear, but the details of your own caseload and decisions are mostly missing. A recruiter can follow your path but may move on without knowing how much work you handle.
Your intake line about screening walk-in clients works well because it names the people and the assistance they needed. Your Ohio LMSW is easy to find, and Experience comes before Education.
